summary_1line: A dog petitions Rama for justice after a brahmin injures it, leading to a paradoxical punishment revealing the karmic burden of religious authority.

image_candidates.scene_text: A wounded dog with a gashed skull stands humbly before King Rama’s royal court, surrounded by sages and ministers.
The brahmin Sarvartha-siddha, honored yet bewildered, rides an elephant after being appointed head of the Kalanjava monastery.
The dog reveals its past life as a former monastery head while Rama and the gathered sages listen in stunned silence.
